leads.name: Cedro de Osorio
leads.reason: Finca de Osorio, Teror (Cabildo-owned public estate open since 1986 as nature classroom, hours not verified). Official register only, no photo or mapped crown, no recent lifecheck, pin approximate: fails covered-country photo-or-pin rule. Oldest cedar on the finca, planted at least 250 years ago per ficha (Cedro de la Casa del Guarda). Walkable cluster with the other Osorio trees. Cabildo ficha: municipality Teror, Público, Visitable, perimeter at 1.30 m 2,60 m, height 10 m, age >300 años. 2026-11-02 second pass: no OSM tree node, no tree-specific iNaturalist or Commons geotag found at this trunk (OSM near the finca has only the Finca de Osorio building, guideposts and a map board). Access: the Cabildo's own page (cabildo.grancanaria.com/osorio/visita-a-la-finca-y-otras-actividades) says entry to the finca, even for the recreational area and trails, requires a permit issued by the Servicio de Medio Ambiente (office Monday to Friday; the Jardin Clasico and exhibition open Monday to Friday, not holidays, by contacting the guard). Permission-gated, so held under hard rule 10 unless Hidde rules a free permit counts as bookable.

leads.name: Las Palmas municipal singular tree catalogue (326 trees)
leads.reason: READ 2026-11-02. The PDF is at https://lpgcsostenible.laspalmasgc.es/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Catalogo_arboles_LPGC.pdf (592 pages, 34 MB; the earlier 404 was the wrong month folder). Ayuntamiento catalogue, December 2024, 116+66+38+103+8 specimens in 5 districts; each ficha has UTM 28N (ETRS89) tree coordinates, perimeter, height, age estimate, ownership. Promoted to gcn_007 to gcn_010: ARB-068 San Telmo figs, ARB-070 Arbol del Responso, ARB-154 Juan de Quesada ombu, ARB-042 Espiritu Santo drago. Further public Vegueta-Triana candidates, not verified: ARB-075 Ficus microcarpa Plaza Diego Mesa de Leon (28.10198,-15.41499; 17 m, crown 17.8 m, +-75/100 yr), ARB-062 Ficus benghalensis and ARB-017 Brachychiton, Plaza Hurtado de Mendoza (28.10229,-15.41562; small), ARB-117 Phoenix plaza San Francisco, ARB-093 Lagunaria San Telmo, ARB-174 Washingtonia Espiritu Santo, ARB-026 Cycas circinalis ex Hospital San Martin (+-175/200 yr, 2.05 m girth, 8 m; courtyard of a building in rehabilitation as the Museo de Bellas Artes since 2021-25, access not public now), ARB-016 Brachychiton Santa Ana (private garden). Outside the centre: ARB-153 Parque Doramas ombu (coordinates in the catalogue duplicate ARB-151 in Los Hoyos, do not use), Tafira trees mostly private.
